blocks.text: ILOILO CITY — A 100-kilo tiger shark accidentally hooked during a traditional jigging competition in Caluya, Antique, was released alive back into the sea on Saturday, Oct. 3, in another remarkable encounter with the rich marine life surrounding the island municipality. The shark, locally called “bagis,” was caught at around 10:30 a.m. by Barangay Alegria Kagawad Lanie Mesullo while participating in the Oktoberfest 2026 Traditional Jigging Competition, according to licensed fisheries technologist and biodiversity researcher Flord Nicson Calawag.
